contradictions.resolution: Kosmos can attach source/code provenance while synthesis claims remain less reliable; provenance and independent verification address different questions.

Product labels and generated reports coexist with expert agenda-setting, claim review and follow-up experiments. Describe the demonstrated workflow rather than adjudicating a universal autonomy label.
Breadth can improve report preference or retrieval coverage while also increasing leakage exposure. Separate search capacity, compute budget and evidence independence.

contradictions.issue: Removing harnesses versus engineering a platform
contradictions.resolution: Edison’s language concerns replacing bespoke tool interfaces with code; its own architecture still uses sandboxes, proxies and persistent storage.

AI Scientist promotional/abstract language can suggest an accepted publication; the 2026 article says first-round review, and protocol withdrew generated submissions. Preserve the narrower procedural observation.

AgentRxiv's reported accuracy includes manual code/output verification; Co-Scientist includes expert selection and laboratory work; Kosmos includes expert validation. Attribute automation to the stages actually delegated.

Kosmos distinguishes data-analysis support from lower synthesis accuracy. Do not turn its aggregate statement-support fraction or estimated time into a general discovery-validity or speedup guarantee.

contradictions.issue: Old failure rates applied to newer systems
contradictions.resolution: Independent v1 counterevidence has a narrow domain/sample. Include alongside later systems without asserting the same rate persists.

contradictions.apparent_conflict: Impressive benchmark performance versus METR 2025 developer slowdown
contradictions.resolution: Different task contexts, success criteria, scaffolds and human interaction; no direct contradiction or universal ranking.
Later observations are selection-biased and explicitly weak evidence for effect size; preserve temporal and design limits.

contradictions.apparent_conflict: A reproduced output versus an incorrect scientific result
contradictions.resolution: NASEM explicitly notes that rerunning erroneous code reproduces an error; independent reasoning and validation remain necessary.
Do not quote a score; describe evaluation design and dated scope.
